name: Hotel Alpenrose
beschreibung: The Hotel Alpenrose is situated in the charming village centre of Galtür in Tyrol's Paznaun Valley, set at a snow-reliable altitude of 1,584 metres above sea level, framed by the soaring massifs of the Silvretta and Verwall ranges. This welcoming, family-managed traditional hotel provides cosy alpine timber-finished guest rooms featuring contemporary en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing panoramic views across glaciated three-thousand-metre peaks. To unwind after exhilarating hours on the pistes or hiking trails, the on-site sauna facility with Finnish sauna, steam room, and relaxation area offers soothing regeneration. Guests start the day with a bountiful breakfast buffet highlighting local Paznaun delicacies, while evening meals feature authentic Tyrolean cuisine. The complimentary ski bus stops right at the property, delivering swift transfers to the high-alpine Silvapark Galtür and nearby Ischgl. In summer, high trails, via ferratas, and the Alpinarium museum await.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine hotel in the centre of Galtür in the Paznaun Valley at 1,584 metres with cosy rooms, saunas, and near Silvapark.
